defs.def: something that you say or do to make people laugh, for example a funny story that you tell 笑话；玩笑

ex.s: My partner joked about being ____46____ with me.

她是一位严格又聪明的老师。

ex.s: You don’t have to be the joke teller in the group in order to show your sense of humor.
ex.t: 你不必成为群体中的笑话王才能展示你的幽默感。

ex.s: drank a toast to     B. played a joke on

ex.s: They rose in the ranks not by being friendly but by smoking cigarettes, breaking rules and playing jokes on others, among whom I soon found myself.
ex.t: 他们不是靠友善而是靠吸烟、违反规则和捉弄别人来提升地位的，我也很快成了他们中的一员。

ex.s: The jokes aren't funny at all.
ex.t: 这些笑话一点也不有趣。

ex.s: We do this by doing magic tricks, singing songs, telling stories and, of course, telling silly jokes.
ex.t: 我们通过变魔术、唱歌、讲故事，当然还有讲傻笑话来做到这一点。

ex.s: It's the one day of the year when people in many parts of the world play practical jokes on each other.
ex.t: 这是每年有一天世界上很多地方的人互相开玩笑的日子。

ex.s: The jokes traditionally last until noon in the UK.
ex.t: 传统上，这些玩笑在英国持续到中午。

ex.s: The joke was played on visitors throughout the 2____________.
ex.t: 这个玩笑被用来在……期间捉弄游客。

defs.def: a person, thing or situation that is ridiculous or annoying and cannot be taken seriously 荒唐可笑的人（或事物）；笑料；笑柄

ex.s: Some looked like they had tally given up on life, while others seemed to be making the best of the situation, smiling and joking.
ex.t: 有些人看起来已经彻底放弃了生活，而另一些人似乎在尽力适应现状，微笑着开玩笑。

defs.def: to say sth to make people laugh; to tell a funny story 说笑话；开玩笑

ex.s: If you can start the conversation with a question other than “What do you do for a living?", you'll be able to get a lot more interesting conversation out of whomever it is you're talking to. ____37 ___. it can bring in "I have this old, broken-down vehicle" or "I rode the bus with these crazy people who were laughing at silly jokes in the back." It just opens up conversation.
ex.t: 快速转过身说："这个蛋糕非常美味，你一定要告诉我它的所有情况。"

defs.def: to say sth that is not true because you think it is funny 闹着玩；说着玩
